description: Shared Rust <-> WASM vectors for action_from_command risk on command lines with shell operators, substitutions, redirections and newlines (issue #272). Expected values are derived by hand from the risk table and rule in crates/allw-core/src/command/risk.rs and docs/policy-seam.md; bin is always the first shlex word (unchanged by #272). Append-only.
